mechanism_narrative: The sharp concurrent collapse in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES signals a broad suppression of out-of-home activity that will continue to drag RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks as fewer commuters and office visitors generate fewer discretionary shopping trips.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not remain below its last-4-week mean over the next 28 days despite TRANSIT and WORKPLACES staying depressed or falling further.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT falls below -50% from baseline, retail access is sufficiently constrained that RETAIL_REC will drop further within one week because travel frictions outweigh any substitution toward local shopping.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline in the week after TRANSIT crosses below -50%, or it rises despite sustained low transit mobility.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL rises while GROCERY_PHARM also falls, households are staying home and consolidating trips, which weakens incidental retail visits and pushes RETAIL_REC lower over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to decline within two weeks after residential stays elevated and grocery/pharmacy turns negative.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous drop in PARKS and RETAIL_REC indicates a broader weekend-excursion collapse; if PARKS remains deeply negative, discretionary outing intensity stays weak and retail recreation stays lower over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rebounds above its prior four-week average while PARKS remains materially below baseline.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of falling WORKPLACES and TRANSIT indicates commuting suppression; if both stay below their last-week levels, retail and recreation will weaken further over the next four weeks because weekday trip chains shrink.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both remain below their prior week levels
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not continue falling over the next 28 days while both commuting proxies remain below their prior week levels.

mechanism_narrative: In a tightening-restrictions regime, a large negative break in GROCERY_PHARM marks broad compliance and risk avoidance; that same behavior suppresses nonessential shopping, so RETAIL_REC should be lower within two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline within two weeks after grocery/pharmacy mobility drops below -10%.

mechanism_narrative: If RESIDENTIAL rises above +20% and TRANSIT stays below -50%, the population is substituting home-based routines for out-of-home trips, which should keep RETAIL_REC depressed over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises materially over the next 28 days despite the home-stay and transit-suppression regime persisting.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in PARKS relative to the prior week signals renewed discretionary movement that spills into shopping trips; if PARKS turns positive after being deeply negative, RETAIL_REC should improve within one week.
candidate_trigger: PARKS increases by at least 15 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise in the week after PARKS posts a large week-on-week rebound, or retail remains flat/negative despite park mobility recovery.
